question: Is a burger a sandwich?
scope: A burger served in a bun. Use ordinary food names; compare constructions and naming conventions without assuming one universal sandwich definition.

turns.text: A burger is a sandwich: it is handheld, with bread around a filling.

rejected.reason: That is already a sandwich. Name a different handheld food.

claims.hint: Name a filled bread food with another identity.

turns.text: A real sandwich needs separate bread slices. A burger comes in a bun.

claims.hint: Name a sandwich made without separate slices.

rejected.reason: That usually uses separate bread slices. Try a roll, wrap, or another construction.

claims.hint: Name another sandwich served in a bun or roll.

turns.text: Wrapping bread around a filling makes it a sandwich. The shape should not matter.

claims.hint: Name another food with an enclosed filling.
Name a food whose shape helps distinguish it.

turns.text: Sandwiches are cold packed lunches. Burgers are hot main meals.

claims.hint: Name a sandwich normally served hot.
Name a sandwich for another meal or occasion.

turns.text: Matching ingredients make matching food categories. A burger shares bread, meat, cheese and sauce with sandwiches.

claims.text: Matching ingredients make matching food categories
claims.hint: Name a different food with overlapping ingredients.
Name another dish using that combination.

turns.text: A food with its own menu heading and special name belongs outside the sandwich family.

claims.hint: Name a sandwich type with its own menu heading.
Name a sandwich with a distinctive name.
